question: Should OpenClaw add a permanent staged model-migration command, and what verification and rollback guarantees should it provide across model providers?
rationale: Source inspection confirms the capability gap but cannot choose whether verification means reachability or deeper agent/tool compatibility, how promotion changes fallback ordering, or where rollback state should live.

options.title: Design staged migration
options.body: Add a provider-generic stage, verify, promote, and rollback workflow that reuses the canonical probe path and documents its exact guarantees.

options.title: Ship probing first
options.body: Keep promotion and rollback manual while the narrower per-model and fallback-chain issues establish a reusable verification primitive.

options.title: Keep manual workflow
options.body: Document fallback-first testing and decline a new persistent migration transaction or command family.

recommendation.title: Design staged migration
recommendation.body: Add a provider-generic stage, verify, promote, and rollback workflow that reuses the canonical probe path and documents its exact guarantees.

likelyOwner.reason: He provided the item-specific product guidance and has the strongest recent history across the affected model-management surfaces.
